title: CsWRKY40-CsRAV1 module integrates auxin and brassinosteroid signaling to cooperatively regulate EGCG biosynthesis in tea plants (Camellia sinensis L.).
authors: Tuo, Yanming; Lu, Xiaofeng; Song, Qingying; Tao, Fang; Zhu, Zhirong; Liu, Yue; Tang, Jun; Shi, Yutao; Zhu, Qiufang; Zhang, Yue; Lin, Jinke; Hu, Yunfei
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过代谢组和转录组分析及分子对接，探讨茶树CsWRKY40-CsRAV1模块协同调控EGCG生物合成，涉及转录因子与DNA结合但缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，且非TF-DNA互作机制建模核心。
abstract: Epigallocatechin-3-gallate (EGCG) is a key secondary metabolite of tea sensory quality and health care function. Auxin and brassinosteroid are important signaling molecules involved in regulating plant secondary metabolism, but the mechanism by which they cooperatively regulate EGCG biosynthesis in tea plants remains unclear. In this study, tea leaves were treated with exogenous indole-3-acetic acid (IAA) and 24-epibrassinolide (BR), and metabolomic together with transcriptomic analyses were used to elucidate how hormone signaling and transcription factors regulate EGCG biosynthesis in tea plants. Compared with the control, combined IAA and BR treatment increased EGCG content in tea plants by 13.25%, indicating a marked enhancement of EGCG accumulation. Additional analysis suggested that CsSAUR and CsBRI1 may be associated with the expression changes of CsWRKY40 and CsRAV1 in response to auxin and brassinosteroid signaling. The results of antisense oligonucleotide (AsODN) inhibition and molecular docking suggested that CsWRKY40 and CsRAV1 may coordinately regulate the expression of the target gene CsPAL in response to auxin and brassinosteroid signals, thereby cooperatively promoting EGCG biosynthesis in tea plants. This study proposes a regulatory framework in which the CsWRKY40-CsRAV1 module may link auxin and brassinosteroid signaling with EGCG biosynthesis in tea plants, providing a new perspective for further investigation of the regulatory mechanisms underlying fresh leaf quality.
abstract_zh: 表没食子儿茶素-3-没食子酸酯（EGCG）是茶叶感官品质和保健功能的关键次生代谢产物。生长素和油菜素甾醇是参与调控植物次生代谢的重要信号分子，但它们协同调控茶树中EGCG生物合成的机制尚不清楚。本研究对茶叶进行外源吲哚-3-乙酸（IAA）和24-表油菜素内酯（BR）处理，并结合代谢组学和转录组学分析，以阐明激素信号和转录因子如何调控茶树中EGCG的生物合成。与对照相比，IAA和BR联合处理使茶树中EGCG含量增加了13.25%，表明EGCG积累显著增强。进一步分析提示，CsSAUR和CsBRI1可能与CsWRKY40和CsRAV1响应生长素和油菜素甾醇信号的表达变化相关。反义寡核苷酸（AsODN）抑制和分子对接结果表明，CsWRKY40和CsRAV1可能协同调控靶基因CsPAL的表达，以响应生长素和油菜素甾醇信号，从而协同促进茶树中EGCG的生物合成。本研究提出了一个调控框架，其中CsWRKY40-CsRAV1模块可能将生长素和油菜素甾醇信号与茶树中EGCG生物合成联系起来，为进一步研究鲜叶品质的调控机制提供了新视角。
